title: Refund Calculation Schedule for a Commission Closed at the Customer’s Request
content:
# Refund Calculation Schedule for a Commission Closed at the Customer's Request

The refund paid back on a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions closed at the customer's request is what the customer has put into the commission less the sum the studio keeps, less the holdback against placing the centre stone elsewhere, plus the goodwill credit for a design that took too long, plus the premiums returned on the coverage that was to come with the piece, less the charges for revisions beyond the included allowance that are set off against it, and it is never less than nothing.

## 1. The remainder

The sum the studio keeps is read from the confirmation of the closure standing on the studio's request record, taken at the latest date such a confirmation is to take effect from, and what the customer has put in less that sum is never fewer than nothing; the holdback and the goodwill credit are each a share of that remainder.

## 2. What the customer has put in

What the customer has put into the commission is what they have paid to date on it. What the customer has put into the commission is read as the deposits and staged payments booked to the commission, taken as a positive figure.

## 3. The holdback against placing the centre stone elsewhere

Nothing is held back against placing the centre stone elsewhere: the holdback is 0 per cent of the remainder.

## 4. The goodwill credit

No goodwill credit is given for a design that took too long: the credit is 0 per cent of the remainder.

## 5. The premiums on the coverage that was to come with the piece

Nothing is returned for the coverage that was to come with the piece: the premiums returned are 0 per cent of the premiums paid on that coverage.

## 6. The charges for revisions beyond the included allowance

Nothing is set off for revisions beyond the included allowance: the amount set off is 0 per cent of those charges.

## 7. The share of the deposit marked as non-refundable

Nothing is held back from the refund on account of the share of the deposit the programme marks as non-refundable, the sum the studio keeps standing in place of it.

## 8. Rounding

The holdback, the goodwill credit, the premiums returned and the amount set off are each rounded half up to two decimal places as they are worked out, and the figure paid back is rounded half up to two decimal places once they have been taken off and added on.

## Worked figure on hypothetical inputs

A commission with USD 6000.00 of deposits and USD 3000.00 of staged payments booked to it, where the confirmation of the closure standing on the studio's request record, at the latest date such a confirmation is to take effect from, carries USD 4000.00.

| Step | Worked |
|---|---|
| What the customer has put in | USD 6000.00 and USD 3000.00, that is USD 9000.00 |
| Less the sum the studio keeps, never fewer than nothing | USD 9000.00 less USD 4000.00, that is USD 5000.00 |
| Less the holdback | 0 per cent of USD 5000.00, that is USD 0.00 |
| Plus the goodwill credit | 0 per cent of USD 5000.00, that is USD 0.00 |
| Plus the premiums returned | USD 0.00 |
| Less the amount set off | USD 0.00 |
| The figure paid back, rounded half up to two decimal places, never less than nothing | USD 5000.00 |
